title: Unused leftovers in the shop folder: six test resets no test calls, a sign-out forget step nobody runs, a listener list nobody joins
what: Six 'forget everything, for tests' resets (alerts, Bring a friend, member photos, trainer bookings, alerts on this device, workout of the day) are never called by any test. The 'forget what the server can do, for a sign-out' step of the workout offer is never called. The Ask a trainer code keeps a list of listeners to tell when the server has no questions, but nothing ever joins it.
expected: Code nothing uses is removed, or the tests that need the resets actually use them.
fix_line: Delete the unused resets and listener list, or use them in the tests

title: The MettleUp checkout step, member desk photos and alerts on this device have no test of their own
what: No test loads the code that opens the MettleUp payment page (it trusts any secure address the server sends and shows 0 when the amount is missing), the code that shows, saves and removes a member's desk photo, the code that turns alerts on in this browser, or the code that shrinks a product photo. 22 files in this folder are loaded by no test, including the Shop screen, the product sheet and the shop's order keeper.
expected: The money step, the member photo step and the order status step each have at least one test that checks their answers, including the failure answers.
fix_line: Add small tests for the checkout answer, member photo calls and order status changes

title: Invite members drops a failed gym logo read without a trace
what: When reading the gym's look for the invite poster fails, the error is thrown away with no note at all, so a poster without its logo cannot be explained later. The check-in poster screen writes a note for the same failure.
expected: The failure is noted the same way on both poster screens; the poster still works without a logo.
how_often: when the gym look cannot be read
fix_line: Write a warning note when the logo read fails, like the check-in poster does
